channel.title: Code-Scanning on Sujith Quintelier
channel.description: Recent content in Code-Scanning on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: github: AI Scan for pull requests generally available
item.description:
AI Scan for pull requests is now generally available in code scanning. It complements CodeQL by detecting vulnerabilities in pull request changes for languages and frameworks not currently covered by CodeQL.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Agentic autofix for code scanning alerts general availability
item.description:
Agentic autofix for code scanning alerts is now generally available. It can investigate relevant files across a codebase and propose fixes for alerts in a developer-like workflow.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Code scanning AI Scan metrics in security overview
item.description:
Organization and enterprise administrators can now view AI Scan for pull request metrics in the security overview. The new metrics track how many AI Scan findings were generated and resolved, along with related status data.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Code scanning AI Scan enablement status in security overview
item.description:
GitHub added AI Scan for pull requests enablement status to the security overview coverage view for organizations and enterprises. The code scanning summary now indicates which repositories have AI Scan enabled or not enabled.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Scheduled code scanning skips inactive repositories
item.description:
Weekly scheduled scans for code scanning default setup and GitHub Code Quality now run only after a repository has had an analysis triggered by a push or pull request. Repositories with no recent activity no longer count toward scheduled scanning.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Code scanning AI Scan no longer requires CodeQL default setup
item.description:
AI Scan for pull requests can now find security vulnerabilities even when CodeQL default setup is not enabled on a repository. Previously, AI Scan for pull requests required CodeQL default setup.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: AI Scan for pull request APIs in public preview
item.description:
GitHub code scanning’s AI Scan for pull request feature can now be enabled and managed via REST API at both the organization and repository levels. The APIs are in public preview.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Code scanning adds a mitigated alert dismissal reason
item.description:
Code scanning now supports dismissing alerts with the reason “Mitigated” when the vulnerability still exists in code but is offset by external controls, such as a web application firewall or network protections.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: CodeQL 2.26.3 improves GitHub Actions queries and JavaScript modeling
item.description:
CodeQL 2.26.3 adds source modeling for JavaScript, TypeScript, and Vue, and updates several GitHub Actions queries for better accuracy. It is a CodeQL release used by GitHub code scanning.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Customize code scanning default setup at scale
item.description:
GitHub added a new repository property, github-codeql-config-file, that lets you apply a custom configuration file to code scanning default setup. This gives you control over how CodeQL runs on repositories at scale.

  • Source: GitHub
